changelog: Public website redesigned: modern hero, category tiles with icons/photos, graphic product cards, features and steps — looks great on mobile and desktop
Public site is now order-only — no prices shown anywhere to customers
Track by mobile number on the homepage: enter your number (WhatsApp OTP when enabled) to see all your orders with live status, progress %, dates, balance and a full timeline
Categories can have an icon (auto-picked from the name when not set) shown on the public site
Fixed a timezone mismatch so 'overdue' and 'today' figures are correct even when the database server runs in UTC
Automatic WhatsApp confirmation is queued the moment a public order is placed
